field.name: state_code
field.comment: Nevada state code

field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: Nevada economic nexus: $100,000 in Nevada receipts (follows Wayfair standard)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: Nevada economic nexus: 200 or more separate transactions

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: Nevada uses single-sales factor for sourcing receipts to Nevada

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: Nevada has NO corporate income tax (Commerce Tax is calculated separately)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: Not applicable - Nevada has no income tax

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: Not applicable - Nevada has no income tax

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: Nevada Commerce Tax credits (renewable energy, data center, film, aviation)

field.name: nv_gross_revenue
field.comment: Nevada-sourced gross revenue for Commerce Tax (receipts from Nevada activities)

field.name: nv_commerce_tax_threshold
field.comment: Nevada Commerce Tax threshold: $4,000,000 in Nevada gross revenue (2025)

field.name: nv_qualifies_for_exemption
field.comment: Nevada gross revenue below $4M threshold - no Commerce Tax due

field.name: nv_business_classification
field.comment: Nevada business classification: financial, mining, retail, professional, manufacturing, other

field.name: nv_commerce_tax_rate
field.comment: Nevada Commerce Tax rate based on industry classification (0.051% default for lowest tier)

field.name: nv_financial_services_rate
field.comment: Financial Services Commerce Tax rate: 0.331% (highest rate)

field.name: nv_mining_rate
field.comment: Mining Commerce Tax rate: 0.262%

field.name: nv_utilities_rate
field.comment: Utilities Commerce Tax rate: 0.266%

field.name: nv_retail_trade_rate
field.comment: Retail Trade Commerce Tax rate: 0.091%

field.name: nv_professional_services_rate
field.comment: Professional, Scientific, Technical Services Commerce Tax rate: 0.128%

field.name: nv_manufacturing_rate
field.comment: Manufacturing Commerce Tax rate: 0.091%

field.name: nv_wholesale_trade_rate
field.comment: Wholesale Trade Commerce Tax rate: 0.101%

field.name: nv_other_rate
field.comment: Other Services Commerce Tax rate: 0.051% (lowest rate)

field.name: nv_taxable_revenue
field.comment: Taxable revenue for Commerce Tax (gross revenue minus $4M threshold)

field.name: nv_commerce_tax
field.comment: Nevada Commerce Tax liability (NOT an income tax - based on gross receipts)

field.name: nv_sitused_revenue
field.comment: Nevada sitused revenue (gross revenue sourced to Nevada using market-based rules)
